about: Stamp capture (PREREGISTRATION-ocr-v19-1-stamps.md, Amendment 1). The 20 S3 'real ink + show-through' pages of the v19 run: S3 pages labelled real-ink in the v19 labels whose note matches /mirror|show-?through|bleed|reversed|behind|other side|verso|recto/i (this reproduces the v19 RESULTS table row exactly: n 20, A .200 A2 .217 B .283 C .400). Words are copied from each page's label note only, written 2026-10-02 before any v19.1 call. A run captures the mark if its BODY contains any listed phrase as whole tokens (lowercased, accents stripped, non-alphanumerics folded to one space). null = the note names no legible word, so the page is excluded from the share.
